scientific_decisions.choice: Use winning frozen global-detail epoch6, same masks/crops/native PARSeq. Frozen-v2 TEST63.5371% versus matched source61.8375%; local spatial variant is not pursued.

Structural word completeness is mean internal learned same-word affinity minus mean outgoing affinity at the finest decoder stage. Exact nearest label mapping to that stage, four directions/radii1,4, invalid RGB/borders excluded; unavailable features bypass filtering. No annotations or text enter this feature.

Fixed source-selected mask threshold/padding; CAL100 jointly chooses closedness and OCR-confidence thresholds. Five image-group folds qualify this readout only if OOF F1 improves by at least0.5points over both OOF confidence-only and the fixed CAL confidence-only baseline. Only a qualified pilot proceeds to TEST300 after selection is sealed. Source/CAL/TEST have historical exposure; all results remain exploratory.

Verified shared RTX3090, FP32 batch1 segmentation; CAL OCR reused only after exact map, geometry and crop hash replay. TEST OCR is new native inference, batch32; record allocated/reserved memory and propagate OOM. No DeepSolo.

Whether learned ownership predicts crop completeness or mainly correlates with area; whether calibration gains transfer. This is a new readout of existing learned neural outputs, not a new backbone or worldwide novelty claim.
